title: Reporting Analyst - 18 month fixed term
text: Reporting Analyst - 18 month fixed term at Australia Post Group (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Every day we deliver a premium service to our customers, but we don’t stop there. We have an unrivalled network, an 11,000 strong team comprising 134 nationalities both male and female who all share common values that drive our shared desire to make a difference for customers. Our passion for people means we’re always looking to grow our team, and provide even greater experiences for our employees. The Business Sales Reporting Analyst role provides a number of reporting services to a wide range of customers, both scheduled and ad hoc. Utilising a range of systems to collate and analyse data, you will work within a collaborative team to fulfil client requests. Furthermore, you will champion our continuous improvement culture across the business. Requirements: Working knowledge of a range of databases. Stakeholder management skills with customers and internal account managers Ability to work and support others within a team environment Deliver reports to required timelines and SLA’s Prior Reporting Analyst experience in a similar or relatable environment What you’ll need: Ability to work with disparate systems to design and build reports Be confident in networking within the business to be able to find and collate appropriate data Experience with Tableau highly regarded, as is fluency with SQL Working knowledge of Alteryx, or similar ETL tool, is required Salesforce experience highly advantageous If you’re ready to put our customers first, we’d love to talk to you. At StarTrack, we’re focused on people, on teamwork and on helping you get the job done. Since joining forces with Australia Post, StarTrack are stronger than ever before, and can now offer both business and consumer markets an unrivalled range of parcel, freight, express, courier and international solutions – all under one banner. Our new combined business brings the trust, reach and convenience that Australia Post is known for, together with the premium service standards of standards of StarTrack, to create the largest parcels, freight logistics provider in the country. And as the largest logistics provider in the country, we know a thing or two about delivery. We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer with a diverse workforce. Enquiries: askrecruitment@startrack.com.au
